purpose: Confirm the frozen V75 completion-Pareto NSESche profile against the unchanged strongest FaaSRank comparator on twenty untouched same-seed tapes before closing operational mechanism selection.

frozen_selection.selection_rule_already_applied: the only V75 candidate strictly exceeding frozen FaaSRank on throughput, finite-only QPR, and zero-as-zero QPR

comparator_scope.reason_single_comparator_is_sufficient_f: The complete V70 nine-baseline paired cohort identified sche_FaaSRank as the strongest comparator for throughput and both QPR definitions. V76 confirms the frozen V75 selection against that comparator; the separate formal E2 matrix remains responsible for the full algorithm panel.

result_blind_execution_order: Commit and push this plan before generating any E450-E469 run spec, tape or output.
Generate one twenty-run FaaSRank manifest and one twenty-run frozen completion-Pareto NSESche manifest from the same fresh source.
Capture twenty base tapes once, derive twenty scale5 tapes and bind identical per-seed hashes to both methods.
Bind the same frozen FaaSRank model payload to both arms and build exactly twenty state-matched NSESche references.
Run FaaSRank E450-E469 first, then completion-Pareto NSESche E450-E469, strictly serially without reading intermediate performance.
Require forty attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact two-way pairing and one runtime identity before opening summaries exactly once.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across twenty paired seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput/(mean completed-request latency*cost) across finite paired runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same QPR with zero-completion or nonfinite-denominator runs contributing zero over all twenty seeds.
analysis.gate: The frozen NSESche candidate mean must strictly exceed the same-seed FaaSRank mean for throughput, finite-only QPR, and zero-as-zero QPR. A tie on any metric fails.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report paired candidate-minus-FaaSRank differences and BCa 95 percent confidence intervals without changing the gate.
analysis.success_action: Close operational mechanism selection and freeze faasrank_native_faithful_completion_pareto for the next formal NSESche matrix.
analysis.failure_action: Retain the complete V76 cohort, mark the selected profile unconfirmed, do not revive score-Pareto or switch by subgroup, and stop this mechanism path.
